questions.question: In power system protection, rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) relays are primarily utilized for which of the following applications?
options: Identifying high-impedance single-line-to-ground faults on distribution feeders
Detecting loss-of-mains (islanding) conditions in distributed generation systems
Mitigating sub-synchronous resonance in series-compensated transmission lines
Measuring dielectric loss factor in high-voltage underground power cables

questions.question: In indirect field-oriented control (FOC) of a three-phase squirrel-cage induction motor, how are the stator current components oriented relative to the rotor flux vector in the synchronously rotating reference frame?
options: The d-axis current component is aligned with the rotor flux vector to control rotor flux, while the q-axis current component is orthogonal to it to control electromagnetic torque.
The q-axis current component is aligned with the rotor flux vector to control rotor flux, while the d-axis current component is orthogonal to it to control electromagnetic torque.
Both the d-axis and q-axis current components are aligned directly with the stator terminal voltage vector.
The d-axis current component controls the mechanical rotor speed directly, while the q-axis current component is maintained at zero under all load conditions.

questions.question: An air-filled rectangular waveguide has a broad internal dimension of a = 3.0 cm and a narrow internal dimension of b = 1.5 cm. Assuming the speed of light in free space is 3 x 10^8 m/s, what is the cutoff frequency for the dominant TE10 mode?
options: 2.5 GHz
10.0 GHz
5.0 GHz
7.5 GHz

questions.question: In power system analysis, two buses (Bus 1 and Bus 2) are connected by a line with a series impedance of Z12 = j0.2 p.u. Neglecting line charging capacitance, what is the value of the off-diagonal entry Y12 in the system's bus admittance matrix (Ybus)?
In symmetrical component analysis of power systems, how does a Delta–Grounded Wye (Delta-Yg) transformer handle zero-sequence currents?
options: Zero-sequence currents flow freely through the transmission line terminals on both the delta and wye sides.
Zero-sequence currents can circulate within the closed delta winding, but cannot enter or leave the line terminals on the delta side.
Zero-sequence currents are completely blocked from flowing in both the wye and delta windings.
Zero-sequence currents on the wye side pass directly to the delta line terminals without returning through the wye neutral.
